title: Cap — Loom Test
script: I recorded the same sixty-second demo in Cap and Loom. Same resolution, frame-rate target, microphone, and script. Setup time stays in the comparison. I checked readable text, cursor movement, edits, captions, and whether sharing worked for another viewer. A feature I could not access on my plan is a limit, not an automatic failure of the entire product. [OUTPUT_AND_WORKFLOW_RESULTS]. [CURRENT_LICENSE_AND_COST_OBSERVATION]. [PERSONAL_COMMERCIAL_AND_TEAM_FIT]. Which recording job matters most to you?
timingStatus: Estimated silent editorial timings. Refit scenes and caption timestamps to the unchanged voice-over when supplied.
concept: Same 60-second demo: setup, quality, cursor, zoom, editing, captions, export and sharing.
whyNow: A practical alternative deserves a current, version-specific check before a viewer changes workflow.
viewerGoal: Decide whether this recorded workflow fits their own devices, plan and needs.
hooks: I recorded the same sixty-second demo in Cap and Loom.
Same demo. Which recording can someone actually use?
The export matters more than the record button.
strongestHook: I recorded the same sixty-second demo in Cap and Loom.
directorBrief: Direct this as a fair matched test with a scoped recommendation: Same 60-second demo: setup, quality, cursor, zoom, editing, captions, export and sharing. Keep real app interaction dominant. The final verdict depends on who can use the tool for this recorded workflow, not a universal winner. Capture version, OS and plan so the evidence can be interpreted.
effort: 30–90 minutes capture/test; large transfers and export waiting may add elapsed time.
protocol: Use identical 60-second demo script, viewport, resolution target, microphone, camera state and plan metadata in Cap and Loom. Log settings that cannot match. Time setup, recording-to-usable-export and sharing. Inspect text at 100%, cursor/zoom, edits, caption accuracy if available and output dimensions. Open share link in a fresh viewer session. Report feature gates and dated cost/license evidence; no unconditional free commercial-use recommendation.
evidenceRequirements: Same capture settings; assess finished videos and true costs.
